name: SlugAudit MCP
description: Pre-parsed, searchable, always-in-sync evidence about a codebase — symbols, imports, dependency edges, source spans — so the AI queries a SQLite database instead of reading hundreds of flat files.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Arbitrary read-only SQL against the project's SQLite index. Joins, CTEs, the lot. Row-capped for safety.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Automatic snapshot of the current revision: file counts, languages, what changed since last import.

tools.name: structure
tools.description: Tree-sitter structural pattern matching across 300+ languages (supports single-file or multi-file AST search with lean snippets).

tools.name: finding
tools.description: Records an audit finding against the evidence, bound to the file's current hash.

tools.name: finding_read
tools.description: Session-gated finding query — returns only the current agent session's findings.

tools.name: project_control
tools.description: Enable or disable a project — creates the activation marker and runs the first import, or purges the project database.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Operational snapshot: watcher health, unreconciled counts, tool-call counters, last-sync timestamp.
